claims.head: The Flyers will hunt a mismatch
claims.call: The Flyers’ L3 (Martone, Cates and Michkov) spends at least 27% of its 5-on-5 time against the Ducks’ fourth line.
claims.body: At home, the Flyers keep sending Michkov’s line (Martone, Cates and Michkov) out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Rick Tocchet has been chasing an easier matchup for the team’s scorers. Tonight the Ducks’ fourth line is Vatrano, McQueen and Klepov.
claims.nums: At home: 27% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against fourth lines, about 13% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Rick Tocchet likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Ducks’ fourth line.

chips.tip: Philadelphia’s L3 (Martone, Cates and Michkov) at home: 27% of its 5-on-5 time against opponents’ fourth lines. Matchups, Philadelphia home games this season, 6 games, 31 minutes for this group at 5-on-5.

PHI.head: Leaning the Flyers’ way
PHI.body: Philadelphia has home-ice advantage, while Anaheim will be without Terry. Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents lately, though. Still, it’s close: the Ducks can make it interesting if they keep the shots coming.

ANA.head: Close, but the Flyers have the slight edge
ANA.body: Philadelphia has home-ice advantage, while Anaheim will be without Terry. Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents lately, though. The Ducks’ best way to tip it is piling up shots.

story.head: The Ducks are searching for answers
